summary: The main allowance, other limits, recent invoices and the plan with Upgrade.
intent: Block: plan usage and what it costs. The main allowance (UsageMeter) beside the plan card with Upgrade as the one solid primary and Manage payment, then the other limits (UsageList) beside recent invoices (ListView, a Download action per row).
useWhen: the billing or usage area of a SaaS settings page
show how close an account is to its limits next to the plan that sets them
download a recent invoice or change the payment method from one place
doNotUseWhen: an overdue account that must pay now (Pay now is the primary, not Upgrade): compose Alert, Button and these parts on the page

plan.note: { name, price, priceNote?, nextCharge?, paymentMethod?, upgradeTo? }. Pre-formatted strings; Upgrade reads "Upgrade to {upgradeTo}".

allowance.note: UsageMeter props without its actions: { title, used, limit, unit?, categories?, periodStart?, resetLabel?, daily?, dailyLabels?, dailyCap?, warnAt?, paceNote? }.

limits.note: UsageList items: { id, label, used, limit, unit?, note? }[]. The card line counts the ones at 80% or more.

invoices.note: { id, number, date, amount, status: "paid" | "open" | "overdue" | "void" }[], newest first.

onUpgrade.note: () => void. The one solid primary, on the plan card. Without it there is no Upgrade.

onManagePayment.note: () => void. Outline button on the plan card.

onDownloadInvoice.note: (invoiceId) => void. Each invoice row's Download action.

onViewInvoices.note: () => void. View all link on the invoices card.

layout: top: the UsageMeter beside the plan Card, in layout-split--primary
then the other limits Card beside the recent invoices Card, in layout-split
the block is its own inline-size container; below --grid-breakpoint-md (64rem) of block width each row stacks

requirements: section aria-labelledby the h2 title; place it inside the page's <main>
the plan facts are a description list (price, next charge, payment method)
Upgrade and Manage payment are kit Buttons; Upgrade is the only solid primary (the UsageMeter's own Upgrade is off)
the invoices list is named with its count (Recent invoices, 4 of 12); each Download action is named with the invoice number
invoice status is a kit Badge with text, not colour alone

doNot: Do not rebuild UsageBilling from local cards; import the block
Do not add a second solid primary; Upgrade on the plan card is the one
Do not pass onUpgrade to the UsageMeter inside it
snippet: <UsageBilling plan={plan} allowance={credits} limits={limits} invoices={invoices} onUpgrade={upgrade} onManagePayment={openPortal} onDownloadInvoice={download} />
